mapper.insert: INSERT INTO replies (post_id, author_id, parent_reply_id, content, status, like_count, created_at) VALUES (#{postId}, #{authorId}, #{parentReplyId}, #{content}, #{status}, #{likeCount}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT r.*, up.nickname AS author_name FROM replies r LEFT JOIN user_profiles up ON r.author_id = up.user_id WHERE r.post_id = #{postId} AND r.status = 'PUBLISHED' ORDER BY r.created_at ASC, r.id ASC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM replies WHERE post_id = #{postId}
mapper.update: UPDATE replies SET post_id = #{postId}, author_id = #{authorId}, parent_reply_id = #{parentReplyId}, content = #{content}, status = #{status}, like_count = #{likeCount}, created_at = #{createdAt} WHERE id = #{id}
